google.calendarHint: Connect a Google account to read its calendars. Mail works without calendar access.
google.contactsHint: Connect Google Contacts to use contact photos. Mail works without contact access.
google.outlookCalendarHint: Connect an Outlook account to read and edit its calendars. Mail works without calendar access.
